verdict: Lam Research posted record revenue of $8.2B, up 54% from a year ago, as AI-driven chip demand lifted systems sales 62% and kept 33 cents of every revenue dollar as profit.

kpis.label: Gross margin
kpis.note: GAAP, up from 50.4% a year ago

segments.name: Systems
segments.note: New wafer-fabrication equipment — deposition, etch and clean tools that chipmakers buy to build advanced chips; up 62% from $3,548M a year ago as AI demand drove fab spending.

segments.name: Customer support & other
segments.note: Services, spares, upgrades and Reliant non-leading-edge equipment for the installed base; up 40% from $1,777M a year ago. The release prints $2,487M before rounding from thousands; shown as $2,486M so the two lines foot exactly to reported revenue.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Developing the next generation of etch, deposition and clean tools.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Sales, support and the back office.

takeaways.title: Record quarter on AI demand
takeaways.text: Revenue hit $8,219M, up from $5,324M a year ago and $6,722M last quarter. Management credited AI driving higher semiconductor demand and greater device complexity.

takeaways.title: Margins expanded too
takeaways.text: GAAP gross margin rose to 52.3% from 50.4% a year ago and the operating margin reached 40.0%, so net income grew even faster than revenue, to $2,753M.

takeaways.title: Guidance points higher
takeaways.text: For the December 2026 quarter Lam guided to revenue of $8.60B plus or minus $400M, with a GAAP gross margin of about 52.5% and operating margin of about 40.5%.

oneTimers: Non-GAAP results were only slightly above GAAP: non-GAAP gross profit was $4,305M versus $4,299M GAAP and non-GAAP net income was $2.77B ($2.20 per share) versus $2,753M ($2.19) GAAP.
otherDetail: Other income, net was $28M — income outside the core equipment business, added after operating income.
footerNote: Figures are in $M and rounded from thousands in the release; cost of goods sold is shown as the $3,920M residual of reported revenue less reported gross profit so the chart foots exactly (the release prints $3,921M before rounding). Net income is GAAP net income of $2,753M.
